pages.headline: The site says it is ready. The start-up lead checks signed budgets, local approvals and training before asking who can give the green light.
pages.body: A site awaiting release. An essential record in the wrong file. A monitoring action marked done. An amendment with local approval pending. A lab mismatch that may be a mapping error. A lock checklist missing sign-off. Each requires applicable evidence, a responsible reviewer and a verified disposition. Orcaworks coordinates these handoffs across clinical systems, vendors and sites.
pages.callout: Quality should be built into the scientific and operational design and conduct of clinical trials.

pages.eyebrow: 01 / Study start-up · Blocker to authorized green light
pages.title: Site activation readiness
pages.problem: A selected site is approaching its planned initiation date, but the signed budget, contract, ethics approval, local consent version and training evidence are not aligned. The start-up lead chases the site, sponsor and country team, then reconstructs the checklist before the person with delegated authority can release or hold the site.
pages.opportunity: Orcaworks compares each site’s configured prerequisites with the current evidence and prepares exact blocker requests. Start-up and clinical operations reviewers verify readiness; the authorized person decides release or hold, and the approved reason and status return to the study record.

rightContent.label: of surveyed site leaders reported more than five months from site selection to full activation.

pages.eyebrow: 02 / Essential records · Exact request to accepted original
pages.title: TMF and site-file reconciliation
pages.problem: An eTMF health check shows a missing delegation log or local approval, while the site says it already filed the document. The CRA compares expected-record rules, file inventories, signatures and versions to determine whether the gap is real, an incorrect expectation or a filing issue before sending another request to the site.
pages.opportunity: Orcaworks compares permitted file indices and verified versions against the applicable expected-record rule. The CRA or TMF reviewer approves a precise request or correction; authorized filing and QC record the accepted original, with inaccessible site evidence remaining visibly outstanding.

rightContent.quote: The TMF should be readily available and directly accessible

pages.eyebrow: 03 / Clinical operations · Site reply to verified closure
pages.title: Monitoring action closure
pages.problem: A monitoring follow-up action is overdue and the site replies that it is done. The CRA still needs the corrected document, resolved query status or dated confirmation required by the monitoring plan. The CTM asks for a sponsor update while the action tracker and the available closure evidence tell different stories.
pages.opportunity: Orcaworks links the finding, site reply and required resolution evidence, then prepares a closure or further-information recommendation. The CRA or delegated CTM approves the disposition; critical findings reach the required medical or Quality reviewer before the controlled action record changes.

rightContent.alt: Lab scientist reviewing printed results beside a workstation

pages.eyebrow: 04 / Regulatory coordination · Released version to verified applicability
pages.title: Amendment rollout by site
pages.problem: The sponsor releases a protocol amendment, but local ethics decisions, translated consent forms, training and effective dates arrive at different times. A site acknowledges the email and the tracker shows sent. The regulatory lead still has to establish which version applies and what each site must complete before the amendment can take effect.
pages.opportunity: Orcaworks prepares a site-by-site evidence matrix using sponsor-defined requirements and local decisions. Regulatory and clinical reviewers verify applicability; the authorized owner records effective or held status, with consent and participant protections remaining under investigator, sponsor and ethics authority.

pages.eyebrow: 05 / Data management · Residual mismatch to controlled correction
pages.title: External data reconciliation
pages.problem: The validated reconciliation run flags a missing lab result or inconsistent subject, visit or sample reference. The data manager checks transfer versions, mapping specifications, vendor files and EDC query history to distinguish a real missing result from a mapping defect. Repeated queries can continue while the underlying cause remains with another team.
pages.opportunity: Orcaworks assembles the residual exception and its transfer history for data management review. The authorized team chooses a vendor correction, controlled mapping change or site query; existing validated processes rerun the checks before the exception is recorded as resolved.

rightContent.quote: ensure the integrity of relevant trial data.

pages.eyebrow: 06 / Study close · Outstanding prerequisites to authorized lock
pages.title: Database-lock readiness
pages.problem: The planned database lock is close, but unresolved queries, investigator signatures, final vendor transfers and safety reconciliation sign-offs sit in different trackers. The lead data manager rebuilds the readiness pack and asks each owner what remains. A checklist that looks complete still needs the study’s medical, statistical and sponsor approvals.
pages.opportunity: Orcaworks reconciles the study’s lock prerequisites with current evidence and named owners, then prepares the readiness pack. Data management verifies completion; required medical, statistics and sponsor authorities approve before an authorized operator performs lock in the validated system.

rightContent.alt: Clinical data manager reviewing trial dashboards across three monitors

pages.title: Every milestone needs evidence and an owner
beforeItems: Site and vendor replies are separate from the controlled study status.
Teams rebuild the same prerequisite or finding before each review.
Acknowledgement can be confused with verified completion.
Sponsor updates lag behind evidence, sign-offs and unresolved holds.
afterItems: Study-linked evidence shows the applicable requirement and latest response.
The next request names the missing record, owner and review point.
Qualified reviewers approve release, acceptance, correction and closure.
Authorized decisions return to the clinical record with residual holds visible.

pages.headline: Start with one site activation blocker
pages.body: Choose a live site approaching an activation milestone. We’ll map the applicable prerequisites, signed versions, external dependencies and delegated release authority with your start-up team. Agree the baseline and evidence needed for a verified disposition, then demonstrate the authorized status recorded in the study workflow before expanding to other sites and study milestones.
